subject.title: [Bug] Telegram exec approval bubble not dismissed after clicking approve

question: Should maintainers adopt, close, or replace the open cross-repository PR that still references this issue?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the open linked PR is conflicting and targets an obsolete handler path, so automation should not create a competing fix until maintainers choose the ownership path.

options.title: Replace with a narrow same-repo fix
options.body: Open or request a focused PR against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` that uses the existing `delete` final-action seam and includes Telegram-visible proof.

options.title: Adopt the linked fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer or contributor rework the linked fork PR to drop unrelated edits, target the active runtime path, and provide real Telegram proof.

options.title: Leave blocked on contributor
options.body: Keep this issue open while waiting for the linked PR author to rebase and retarget the branch, accepting slower cleanup.

recommendation.title: Replace with a narrow same-repo fix
recommendation.body: Open or request a focused PR against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` that uses the existing `delete` final-action seam and includes Telegram-visible proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the active approval lifecycle refactor and are the strongest history signal for the runtime seam involved.
